Supreme Court of the United States 

DAVID BABCOCK, 

Petitioner, 

v. 

KILOLO KIJAKAZI, ACTING COMMISSIONER OF SOCIAL SECURITY, 

Respondent. 

APPLICATION FOR AN EXTENSION OF TIME  
TO FILE REPLY BRIEF 

RONALD M. BAHRIE
JUSTIN M. BAHRIE

  Counsel of Record

HOGAN LOVELLS US LLP 
555 Thirteenth St., N.W.   
Washington, D.C. 20004  
(202) 637-5600  
neal.katyal@hoganlovells.com 

Counsel for Petitioner 

August 5, 2021

APPLICATION 

To the Honorable Brett M. Kavanaugh, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court 

of the United States and Circuit Justice for the Sixth Circuit: 

Pursuant to Rule 30.3 of the Rules of this Court, Petitioner David Babcock re-

spectfully requests a 14-day extension of time, to and including September 8, 2021, 

within which to file his reply brief on the merits. 

1.

On March 12, 2021, the parties in this case jointly moved pursuant to 

Supreme Court Rule 30.4 to extend the time within which to file Petitioner’s opening 

brief and Respondent’s brief on the merits.  The Court granted that motion on March 

22, 2021, extending the due dates to May 20 and July 26, 2021, respectively. 

2.

The reply brief for Petitioner is currently due on August 25, 2021, and 

the Court has scheduled argument for October 13, 2021.  With the 14-day extension 

requested in this application, the reply brief would be due on September 8, 2021. 

3.

This  is  Petitioner’s  first request  for  an  extension  of time for the  reply 

brief, which Petitioner held until this Court had set oral argument.     

4.

The extension is warranted because of a press of other matters under-

signed counsel is handling that are pending in this Court and other courts, including 

filing deadlines and preparation for argument in several upcoming cases.  

5.

Counsel for Respondent has consented to this extension. 

For  these  reasons,  Petitioner  respectfully  requests  that  an  order  be  entered 

extending the time to file the reply brief to and including September 8, 2021. 

1

RONALD M. BAHRIE
JUSTIN M. BAHRIE
NICHOLAS A. KIPA
BAHRIE LAW, PLLC

Lansing, MI 48911
